| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|---------------|---------------------|

| Fold14 MDD | **-9.3%** | -10.0% |

## Assessment

**Champion remains stronger overall.** The candidate (`exp_macro_alpha_shadow`) passed validation but shows:
- ⚠️ Concerning tuning minimum (0.05) suggests instability on at least one fold
- Slightly worse drawdown profile
- Marginal lockbox min improvement doesn't offset tuning fragility

## Recommended Next Steps

```bash

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \

# 2. Run system-level candidate exploration  
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate diagnostic report for next improvement target
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Notes for Next Session
- Champion v5 stable at ~-9.3% worst MDD
- Focus tuning efforts on improving minimum fold performance
- Consider investigating fold14 specifically—it's driving worst-case for both models
